//: Open wounds and infection. Prologue design values; the ids listed are CDDA ids used as wound cleaners.
source: AIR design, 18.09.2026. Severity bands, chances and stage lengths are original balance, not CDDA numbers.
//scratchDeepenChance: Skin already torn takes a second cut worse than the first: this is the chance a scratch across an existing scratch opens into a gash.

infection.//exposure: An open wound is rolled every hour it is exposed. Bare, it is exposed for as long as it is open; under a dressing it is exposed at the bandaged rate for `bandageGraceHours` more and then not at all while the dressing holds. A wound kept clean is rolled at the cleaned rate. A dressing and a cleaning each last `careHours`; doing it again starts the clock again. The survivor is told when a wound wants care, and again every `remindHours` while it still does.
infection.//: Original AIR stochastic race: every step advances severity or immunity, or naturally clears infection. Food, water and rest support immunity; treatment slows severity. Forecast uses the exact absorbing probability at current conditions. Historical population balance benchmarks are measured by scripts/calibrate-infection.mjs, not substituted for individual risk.

cleaners.//: Anything that can be put on a wound. How much it helps is in `treatments`.

treatments.//: Multiplier on how fast the sickness gains ground while the treatment is fresh. Lower is better, none of them cure.

training.//: First-aid practice for treating a wound: XP per bandaging (plus perQuality for each grade of the dressing) and per cleaning. Care is the way the skill is meant to be learned.
